# Pantheon of One

**Version 1.5** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3811559970) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=pantheon-of-one&expanded=true)

Play as a god. Not a king with a halo: a god whose power is the worship of the
faithful, and whose gifts to them are overwhelming but never permanent.

You don't need to conquer the world. You need it to pray to you.

---

## Becoming a god

1. Take the decision **Ascend to Godhood**. You become **Divine**:
  immortal, untouched by disease or wounds, +30 to every skill and +100 prowess.
  No hostile scheme against you can succeed, no prison can hold you, and religion
  costs you nothing.
1. Right-click yourself and choose **Divine Will**.
1. *Optional:* to be worshipped under your own name, create a branched
  rite in the Religion screen (free for a god), then **Proclaim Your
  Divinity**: it becomes a faith of its own.
1. **Take Your Throne in Heaven**. You become the living, independent Head
  of your faith, ruling from an impregnable **Holy Seat**.

**Divine Offspring:** forswear mortal children, or let your children be born
**Demigods**: gifted, beautiful and brilliant, legitimate, though mortal.
**Divine Conception** lets you father (or bear) a demigod with any follower, as
an honour, never a scandal. And **Guardians of the Holy Seat**, your own
divine regiment, keep raiders from holy ground.

---

## Worship and Devotion

Every season, Worship flows to you from every county and every ruler of your
faith, and a notification tells you how much. Every follower has a
**Devotion**: the devout give twice as much and never leave you; the
wavering give nothing, and may turn to another faith.

## Prayers

Your followers pray to you when they are in need: for the Host in a losing
war, for children, a spouse, healing, long life, protection from plague, a
harvest, or a divine gift. **Grant** it, **send a sign**, or
**refuse**, and their Devotion follows. Strangers of other faiths may pray
too, and follow you if you help them. Game rule: Prayer Frequency.

---

## Wrath

Right-click an enemy of your faith, an apostate, or a sinner among your
followers and choose **Pass Judgement**:

- **Strike the person**: strike them down, maim them, or curse them
- **Strike their lands**: Pestilence, The Great Dying (a plague that will
  spread, perhaps to your own), or a Disaster that brings a building down

A sin weighs less than a crime: sinners can only be cursed or maimed. Your
devout are never judged. And when an infidel makes war on your devout or your
holy sites, or anyone makes war on you, **Divine Retribution** asks how you
answer. Strike an enemy and your followers are in awe; strike your own and the
faithful fear you.

## Great Prayers

Your most devout remember who wronged them: a murdered kinsman, a war lost to
an unbeliever, a holy site seized, a cell, a torturer. In time they beg you for
vengeance. **Swear it** and strike, and they are yours forever, with a
thank-offering and the awe of the whole faith. Refuse, and they remember; swear
and stay your hand, and they never forgive. The tortured accept nothing less
than blood or a broken body.

---

## Divine Will

Right-click any follower (or yourself) and choose **Divine Will**:

- **A divine gift**, for five years: Champion, Warlord, Sovereign or Sage
- **Bless their lands**, for ten years: a bountiful harvest, unbreachable
  walls, or warding from plague
- **Bless their life**: divine vigor (no aging), divine fertility, or a
  blessed lineage (their next child is born a beautiful genius)
- **The Host of Heaven**: an army of overwhelming divine soldiers descends
  to fight in one of their wars, and returns to heaven when the war ends

**Your Blessed** shows who carries your gifts and until when, and a notice
tells you when a boon fades (game rule: All, Divine Gifts Only, Off).

---

## Game rule: Divine Economy

- **Earned Godhood** (default): Worship flows modestly and boons are costly.
- **Sandbox God**: Worship flows five times faster, boons cost a quarter,
  and they last twice as long.

For Crusader Kings III 1.20. Compatible with most mods: Pantheon of One only
adds its own content and appends to vanilla hooks, replacing nothing.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `pantheon-of-one-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=pantheon-of-one&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
